item.title: Eliciting Personality Traits in Large Language Models
item.description:
Date: N/A
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Natural Language Processing", "Machine Learning", "Personality Modeling"]
Summary:
  • The paper studies how to elicit personality traits in large language models.
  • It explores various methods for trait elicitation.
  • The research aims to improve model interaction and personalization.
  • Results show potential for more human-like responses.
  • The study contributes to AI personality modeling.

item.title: Mind the Gap: Evaluating Model- and Agentic-Level Vulnerabilities in LLMs with Action Graphs
item.description:
Author: Ilham Wicaksono, Zekun Wu, Rahul Patel, Theo King, Adriano Koshiyama, Philip Treleaven
Date: N/A
Tags: ["Large Language Models", "AI Safety", "Agentic Systems", "Security Evaluation", "Machine Learning Vulnerabilities"]
Summary:
  • Large language models are evolving into agentic systems.
  • Current safety evaluations miss deployment-specific risks.
  • AgentSeer framework breaks down agent actions for detailed assessment.
  • Agentic-level vulnerabilities differ from model-level ones.
  • Tool-calling shows higher attack success rates in agentic contexts.
  • AgentSeer highlights the need for new evaluation methods.

item.title: White Paper Regulation of HR Tech: The Key Laws You Need to Know [October 2025]
item.description:
Author: Rahul
Date: N/A
Tags: ["HR Technology", "AI Regulation", "Data Privacy", "Compliance", "Human Resources Management"]
Summary:
  • HR technology compliance is increasingly important.
  • AI tools are widely used in recruitment and management.
  • Key laws include the EU AI Act and NYC Local Law 144.
  • Organizations must implement bias detection and regular audits.
  • Aligning AI with ethics and priorities is crucial.
  • Proactive regulation adherence builds trust and innovation.
